context: A boss briefs his manager on a sudden site relocation
purpose: Teach: 急遽/極力/高値/立地/阻害/所要/先般/取扱い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 先般の打合せで話した件だが、現場が急遽移転することになった。
lines.en: Regarding what we discussed the other day, the site is being relocated on short notice.
lines.style: Authoritative, clipped, delivering serious news without preamble

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: えっ、本当ですか。新しい立地はもう決まっているんですか？
lines.en: What, really? Has the new location already been decided?
lines.style: Startled office worker, polite but visibly thrown off

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、駅前の物件だ。立地条件は申し分ないが、賃料がかなりの高値でな。
lines.en: Yes, the property by the station. The location is excellent, but the rent is quite steep.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, weighing pros and cons aloud

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 高値となると予算が厳しいですね。所要経費の見直しが必要になりそうです。
lines.en: If the rent is that high, the budget will be tight. We'll need to review the required expenses.
lines.style: Analytical manager, mentally running the numbers

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そこなんだ。業務の阻害要因にならないよう、移転は極力スムーズに進めたい。
lines.en: Exactly. To avoid disrupting operations, I want the move to go as smoothly as possible.
lines.style: Pragmatic and firm, setting clear priorities

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。機密書類の取扱いについては私の方で手順をまとめておきます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare the procedures for handling the confidential documents on my end.
lines.style: Composed, taking ownership of the task

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼んだぞ。明日の朝一で全員に説明する。それまでに案を持ってきてくれ。
lines.en: I'm counting on you. I'll brief everyone first thing tomorrow. Bring me a plan by then.
lines.style: Decisive close, delegating with full confidence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。今夜中に骨子を作成してお持ちします。
lines.en: Certainly. I'll draft an outline by tonight and bring it to you.
lines.style: Crisp, formal acceptance signaling the meeting is over
